about_the_game:
Vribyss Refuge Metamorphosis is a fantasy RPG that explores the theme of refugees fleeing religious persecution. Since 2014, the game's creator has traveled to East Africa and various parts of Asia, visiting refugee camps and villages, and listening to the stories of refugees. The experiences of these refugees inspire the stories shared by the NPCs in the game.

KEY FEATURES

• Short Playthrough - 30 to 90 Minutes of Gameplay

• Kinetic Visual Novel-like NPC Dialogue

• Five Fantasy Open World Nations to explore

• Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment Based Combat (DDA) based on the number of enemies defeated and/or the number of times the player dies.

• Increase Max Health - Energy Pickups can be found throughout the world to increase your max health

• Parkour Abilities

• Strafing Mode w/ Enemy Target Lock System

• Eight Sword Attacks - including one light and seven heavy

• Replayability - Choice-based alternate ending

• 6/8 Refugee NPCs appear in random places every time the game restarts. Find them to learn their stories.

• Support for Ultra Wide Monitors - (32:9)

• Downloadable Controller Mapping PDF

STORY

Bitter from the pain of his past, Andel seeks out Aphass Kexxir, King of the Kexxrans, to stop the Vribyss exploitation responsible for the greatest refugee crisis their world had ever seen. In his pursuit, he encounters displaced people who reveal more about his mysterious past. On his journey, Andel comes to realize that Aphass Kexxir is operating with a supernatural force greater than anything he'd experienced before. Andel begins to seek solutions in the unseen world as he notices his natural skills and combat strategies aren't enough.

content_descriptors.notes: Because of the nature of religious persecution, the Vribyss Refuge ™ Metamorphosis story contains mature themes in the text-based dialogue. Some of these themes include references to trauma, self-harm, murder, sexual abuse, kidnapping, and fantasy religious discrimination. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K@3.3GHz or AMD FX 6300@3.5GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1060 GTX (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bits
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K@3.5GHz or Ryzen 5 1500X@3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3070 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon Pro 5500XT (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Vribyss Refuge Metamorphosis is a small fantasy RPG about a refugee seeking out others who've also been displaced because of religious persecution.
